Now i know for a fact this is all bullshit, if he really went 23-0 as a pro boxer surely something would show up when i google his name right. And it was just the two of us when i called him out but i will admit i told some of the coworkers i liked.

Calling him out in a private setting (just the two of you) was reasonable, especially since he was the one escalating the conversation with UFC commentary. 2. **You gave him a fair challenge** – Instead of just mocking him, you offered a real test (a muay thai gym fight), which is a mature way to settle the dispute.
